// Handwritten direct-Wasm proof, not generated class support.
// ignore_for_file: import_internal_library
import 'dart:_wasm';
import 'dart:_js_interop_wasm';
import 'dart:js_interop';

int constructorCalls = 0;
int opaqueCalls = 0;
int numberCalls = 0;

class Counter {
  Counter(this.value) {
    constructorCalls++;
  }
  int value;
  int add(int delta) => value += delta;
}

// Keeping raw JS payloads here avoids conflating JS undefined with Dart null.
// This experimental wrapper is deliberately not a proposed public opaque API.
class OpaqueValue {
  const OpaqueValue(this.reference);
  final WasmExternRef? reference;
}

OpaqueValue requiredOpaque(OpaqueValue value) {
  opaqueCalls++;
  return value;
}

OpaqueValue optionalOpaque([OpaqueValue? value]) {
  opaqueCalls++;
  return value ?? OpaqueValue(externRefForJSAny('dart-default'.toJS));
}

int optionalNumber([int value = 7]) {
  numberCalls++;
  return value;
}

@pragma('wasm:export', 'counterNew')
WasmExternRef counterNew(WasmI32 initial) =>
    WasmAnyRef.fromObject(Counter(initial.toIntSigned())).externalize();

@pragma('wasm:export', 'counterAdd')
WasmI32 counterAdd(WasmExternRef ref, WasmI32 delta) {
  final counter = ref.internalize().toObject() as Counter;
  return WasmI32.fromInt(counter.add(delta.toIntSigned()));
}

@pragma('wasm:export', 'counterValue')
WasmI32 counterValue(WasmExternRef ref) =>
    WasmI32.fromInt((ref.internalize().toObject() as Counter).value);

@pragma('wasm:export', 'requiredOpaqueCall')
WasmExternRef? requiredOpaqueCall(WasmExternRef? ref) =>
    requiredOpaque(OpaqueValue(ref)).reference;

@pragma('wasm:export', 'optionalOpaqueCall')
WasmExternRef? optionalOpaqueCall(WasmI32 present, WasmExternRef? ref) =>
    (present.toIntSigned() == 0
            ? optionalOpaque()
            : optionalOpaque(OpaqueValue(ref)))
        .reference;

@pragma('wasm:export', 'optionalNumberCall')
WasmI32 optionalNumberCall(WasmI32 present, WasmI32 value) => WasmI32.fromInt(
  present.toIntSigned() == 0
      ? optionalNumber()
      : optionalNumber(value.toIntSigned()),
);

@pragma('wasm:export', 'constructorCount')
WasmI32 constructorCount() => WasmI32.fromInt(constructorCalls);

@pragma('wasm:export', 'opaqueCount')
WasmI32 opaqueCount() => WasmI32.fromInt(opaqueCalls);

@pragma('wasm:export', 'numberCount')
WasmI32 numberCount() => WasmI32.fromInt(numberCalls);

void main() => throw StateError('Consumer must never invoke Dart main');
